subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: li+and pairs mean a 64-bit AND. Globals reloaded inside an inlined body mean the callee reads globals, not parameters. `andi.` needs a positive literal mask. u8 pad arrays reproduce stack gaps. A `bl` with a macro-name relocation means a lost #define: check that FIRST before any register-allocation theory. Ghidra decompile showing `q >> 32` garbage is the uninitialized-return tell.
